dataset_spec.name: uci_cirrhosis
dataset_spec.description: UCI Cirrhosis Patient Survival (Mayo Clinic primary biliary cholangitis trial and registry, 1974-1984; 418 patients). 17 baseline predictors; the literal string NaNN marks values not collected for the 106 non-trial patients. Binary death (vs alive or transplanted) by the July 1986 analysis.
dataset_spec.setting: Adult with primary biliary cholangitis (then called primary biliary cirrhosis) referred to the Mayo Clinic between 1974 and 1984, either randomised to D-penicillamine or placebo or followed outside the trial. The observations are the baseline examination and laboratory values at registration; follow-up ran from registration to the July 1986 analysis.

text_values.S: Oedema without diuretics, or resolved by diuretics

classes: Alive or transplanted at end of follow-up

mapping.0: Alive or transplanted at end of follow-up

cirrhosis_died.question: Based on these baseline findings, did the patient die during the study follow-up (registration 1974-1984, follow-up to July 1986) rather than remaining alive or receiving a liver transplant?
